svg.text: Dynamic Programming · O(n) · Kadane's: extend or restart, nothing else.

g.text: Start at -2. Carry the best sum ending here.
-2 + 1 = -1 is worse than 1 alone — restart here.
-2 + 4 = 2 is worse than 4 alone — restart here.
One pass, no nested loop — O(n).
